content.what_it_is: MATLAB current-field plotter for output 00001. It defines 2 m x/y vectors, loads mean u/v plus a static mask and depth, masks velocities where mask is zero, plots negative depth, overlays subsampled/scaled velocity arrows and a 25 cm/s reference arrow, marks NaN-u locations as sand-colored points, and saves figures/current.jpg (L1-L49).

coordinate vectors x and y defined at L5-L6
file selector file_no defined numerically at L7 and reformatted at L10
mesh grids xx and yy defined at L9
mean velocities u and v loaded at L11-L12 and masked at L15-L16
mask and depth arrays loaded at L13-L14
colorbar handle h defined at L19
subsampling steps skx/sky and arrow scale cc defined at L27-L29
flattened coordinates XX1D/YY1D and velocity onedim defined at L38-L40

unresolved: Potential quiver interface mismatch across L5-L6 and L30-L32: x and y are row vectors (subsampled to lengths 50 and 100), while u/v slices are 100x50 matrices. Unlike the already available xx/yy grids from L9, these coordinate arguments are not shaped to match U/V; correctness depends on whether the MATLAB version expands vector coordinates for quiver.

Range/version risk at L43-L44: copper is called without an explicit row count and row 190 is then indexed. Environments returning the legacy 64-row default colormap raise an out-of-range error; the intended 190th color should request a sufficiently large table explicitly.
All u/v/mask/depth arrays are assumed to match the hard-coded 500x250 coordinate grid at L5-L16, with no dimension check before masking or plotting.
Dry points at L41-L45 are defined by every NaN in u after L15, so pre-existing numerical NaNs are indistinguishable from mask-derived dry cells and are plotted as sand.
MATLAB pcolor at L18 ordinarily omits the final depth row and column as colored faces.
The figures directory used at L48 is not created or checked before saveas.
